provenance: Self-authored sources executed by original installed G1 build15751 in disposable virtual profiles. Complete5x5 pixel buffers, no masks or tolerances. No vendor assets or physical hardware claim.

cases.name: rect0
cases.source: EXPORT RECTCASE() BEGIN DIMGROB_P(G1,5,5,#112233h); RECT_P(G1,1,1,3,3,#FF0000h,#FFh); LOCAL x,y,out:={}; FOR y FROM 0 TO 4 DO FOR x FROM 0 TO 4 DO out:=CONCAT(out,{B→R(GETPIX_P(G1,x,y))}); END; END; RETURN out; END;
